Full-stack application / 2026

Customer relationships.
Secure foundations.

A customer relationship management application with authenticated access, role-based permissions, and a reliable home for customer data.

  • RESTful CRUD endpoints with JSON responses
  • Role-based authorization with Spring Security
  • MySQL persistence through JPA and Hibernate
JavaSpring BootMySQLThymeleaf
Inside the build +

Built with Spring Boot 4 and Spring Framework 7, using Maven for builds and Bootstrap for the interface. HTTP status codes communicate errors, while Spring Data JPA and Hibernate map customer records to the database.
